类 PropertiesDefaultHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • jdk.internal.org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
      • jdk.internal.util.xml.PropertiesDefaultHandler
  • 所有已实现的接口:

    public class PropertiesDefaultHandler
extends DefaultHandler
    A class used to aid in Properties load and save in XML. This class is re-implemented using a subset of SAX
    从以下版本开始:

      • startElement

        public void startElement(String uri,
                         String localName,
                         String qName,
                         Attributes attributes)
                  throws SAXException
        从类复制的说明: DefaultHandler
        Receive notification of the start of an element.

        By default, do nothing. Application writers may override this method in a subclass to take specific actions at the start of each element (such as allocating a new tree node or writing output to a file).

        指定者:
        startElement 在接口中 ContentHandler
        覆盖:
        startElement 在类中 DefaultHandler
        参数:
        uri - The Namespace URI, or the empty string if the element has no Namespace URI or if Namespace processing is not being performed.
        localName - The local name (without prefix), or the empty string if Namespace processing is not being performed.
        qName - The qualified name (with prefix), or the empty string if qualified names are not available.
        attributes - The attributes attached to the element. If there are no attributes, it shall be an empty Attributes object.
        抛出:
        SAXException
        另请参阅:
        ContentHandler.startElement(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.xml.sax.Attributes)

      • characters

        public void characters(char[] ch,
                       int start,
                       int length)
                throws SAXException
        从类复制的说明: DefaultHandler
        Receive notification of character data inside an element.

        By default, do nothing. Application writers may override this method to take specific actions for each chunk of character data (such as adding the data to a node or buffer, or printing it to a file).

        指定者:
        characters 在接口中 ContentHandler
        覆盖:
        characters 在类中 DefaultHandler
        参数:
        ch - The characters.
        start - The start position in the character array.
        length - The number of characters to use from the character array.
        抛出:
        SAXException
        另请参阅:
        ContentHandler.characters(char[], int, int)

      • resolveEntity

        public InputSource resolveEntity(String pubid,
                                 String sysid)
                          throws SAXException,
                                 IOException
        从类复制的说明: DefaultHandler
        Resolve an external entity.

        Always return null, so that the parser will use the system identifier provided in the XML document. This method implements the SAX default behaviour: application writers can override it in a subclass to do special translations such as catalog lookups or URI redirection.

        指定者:
        resolveEntity 在接口中 EntityResolver
        覆盖:
        resolveEntity 在类中 DefaultHandler
        参数:
        pubid - The public identifier, or null if none is available.
        sysid - The system identifier provided in the XML document.
        返回:
        The new input source, or null to require the default behaviour.
        抛出:
        IOException - A Java-specific IO exception, possibly the result of creating a new InputStream or Reader for the InputSource.
        SAXException
        另请参阅:
        EntityResolver.resolveEntity(java.lang.String, java.lang.String)

        public void error(SAXParseException x)

      • fatalError

        public void fatalError(SAXParseException x)
                throws SAXException
        从类复制的说明: DefaultHandler
        Report a fatal XML parsing error.

        The default implementation throws a SAXParseException. Application writers may override this method in a subclass if they need to take specific actions for each fatal error (such as collecting all of the errors into a single report): in any case, the application must stop all regular processing when this method is invoked, since the document is no longer reliable, and the parser may no longer report parsing events.

        指定者:
        fatalError 在接口中 ErrorHandler
        覆盖:
        fatalError 在类中 DefaultHandler
        参数:
        x - The error information encoded as an exception.
        抛出:
        SAXException
        另请参阅:
        ErrorHandler.fatalError(org.xml.sax.SAXParseException), SAXParseException
